article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official Free Realms news post marking the game's second anniversary. It reports 17 million registered users across PC, Mac and PlayStation 3, recaps the April 28, 2009 PC launch, and lists birthday-season highlights (new houses and lands, new careers, farming, annual celebrations, Robatesoros battles, and famous guest characters). The post gives no dates beyond the launch date and no details on how these features work.
